description: List one ad channel's campaigns for the last N days, biggest spend first: status, objective, daily or lifetime budget, currency, spend and clicks (from the ad platform), and what the CRM recorded for the campaign — leads, deals, won deals, orders, sales, revenue, costPerLead. roas is revenue divided by spend, and is null — never guessed — when the ad account's currency differs from reportingCurrency, because that would invent an exchange rate; revenue is in reportingCurrency only. Read-only, from stored state, no ad platform is called. Use list_ad_accounts for the provider keys, list_ad_recommendations for what to do next, and get_report for the CRM's own sales reports.

days.description: How many days back spend, clicks and results are summed, ending today. Default 30, at most 30 (the CRM keeps 30 days).

provider.description: The ad channel, as listed by list_ad_accounts (for example google or openai).

name: list_ad_campaigns
title: List ad campaigns
